subject: 5-Bullet Friday — South Park’s Storytelling Strategy, Breaking YouTube’s “Best Practices,” AI for Science, and Supplements for Endurance

bullets.title: Consensus: AI Search Engine for Research
bullets.note: Thanks to Richard Reis of [Most Recommended Books](https://www.mostrecommendedbooks.com/) for the tip, which was a response to [this post of mine](https://x.com/tferriss/status/1826366945882767397) about science-focused AI tools. Here’s the synopsis, pun intended: “Consensus is an academic search engine, powered by AI, but grounded in scientific research. We use language models (LLMs) and purpose-built search technology (Vector search) to surface the most relevant papers. We synthesize both topic-level and paper-level insights. Everything is connected to real research papers.”

bullets.title: HumanN SuperBeets Beetroot Powder
bullets.note: I have repeatedly seen endurance benefits from using this at altitude. Now, it could be placebo effect, but guess what? We can investigate using the aforementioned tool. [Here’s what it brings up](https://consensus.app/results/?q=is%20there%20any%20compelling%20evidence%20for%20beet%20root%20for%20endurance%20improvement%3F&synthesize=on).
